```yaml
name: Build Release

on:
  release:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build frontend assets
        run: npm run build

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.2'
          coverage: none

      - name: Install PHP production dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --prefer-dist --no-interaction

      - name: Create production zip
        run: |
          # Create a temporary directory for the build
          mkdir -p build/pressforward
          
          # Use rsync to copy files, excluding those in .distignore
          # If .distignore exists, use it; otherwise use a default set of exclusions
          if [ -f .distignore ]; then
            rsync -a --exclude-from='.distignore' . build/pressforward/
          else
            rsync -a \
              --exclude='.git' \
              --exclude='.github' \
              --exclude='node_modules' \
              --exclude='vendor' \
              --exclude='*.md' \
              --exclude='*.json' \
              --exclude='*.lock' \
              --exclude='tests' \
              --exclude='src' \
              --exclude='assets/src' \
              --exclude='.distignore' \
              --exclude='build' \
              . build/pressforward/
          fi
          
          # Create the zip file
          cd build
          zip -r pressforward.zip pressforward/

      - name: Upload artifact to Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        run: |
          gh release upload "$TAG_NAME" build/pressforward.zip --clobber
```
